Software Engineer

LocationOn-Site, Plassey, Nadia
Experience0 to 3 Years
TeamTechnology & Innovation
Compensation₹4 – 8 LPA
Apply for this role

Build Things That People Actually Use

At Studio 1947, we don't just write code. We solve problems.

We're looking for Software Engineers who enjoy turning ideas into working software. That might be platforms, dashboards, websites, AI-powered tools, internal systems or custom products for clients. Whatever it is, you'll help build technology that adds real value.

You'll work closely with designers, researchers, strategists and product thinkers to build things that work well, scale and are thoughtfully designed.

We care less about how many programming languages you know and more about how you think, learn and solve problems.

What You'll Do

  1. 01

    Build web applications, platforms, dashboards and digital products.

  2. 02

    Work with designers to turn concepts into smooth user experiences.

  3. 03

    Write clean code that scales and is easy to maintain.

  4. 04

    Take part in product planning, architecture discussions and technical decisions.

  5. 05

    Integrate APIs, databases, and third-party services.

  6. 06

    Test, debug and tune applications so they're fast and reliable.

  7. 07

    Contribute to AI, automation and new technology projects.

  8. 08

    Keep improving how we build and ship.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with modern development frameworks and technologies.
  • Understanding of frontend and/or backend development.
  • Familiarity with databases and API integrations.
  • Ability to write clean, efficient code.
  • Willingness to learn new tools and adapt quickly.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms and deployment workflows.
  • Experience building SaaS products or internal tools.
  • Interest in AI, automation and new technologies.

Why Join Studio 1947?

You'll work on varied projects rather than the same product every day. One month you might build a research platform. The next, an AI-powered dashboard. After that, a website for an ambitious startup.

We value experimenting, learning and taking ownership. If you enjoy building products that matter with a creative team, you'll feel at home here.

Ready to Apply?

Share your CV, GitHub profile, portfolio, side projects, or anything you've built. We love seeing real work and creative problem-solving.
